blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation applied to National Government & Digital Services. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

National digital government builds shared rails — identity, data exchange, notification, payments — and industrializes citizen services on top. Success is measured in take-up, resolution and trust; failure modes are silos, legacy cores and unaccountable AI.

items: Citizens re-submit facts; fraud/error hide at seams.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Digital Workforce & Multi-Agent Orchestration, Process & Task Mining, Autonomous Workflow Orchestration from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Citizen service delivery, Benefits/licensing casework, Interagency data exchange) on Dataq Swarm and Dataq Nexus and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — GDPR/national privacy among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: One automation spine: APIs, events, RPA and agents composable under common control.
Workflows that recover from failure on their own — long-running business processes that adapt, retry and recover without tickets.
Agents that execute the work: tool-using, policy-bounded, and fully logged for audit.
Evidence assembly with officer approval gates (backlogs down)

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Public Sector & Government level this capability reads as: cross-agency analytics scoring anomalies with investigator case packs (capture up at stable load). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Delivery follows the same weekly rhythm on every program of this type. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
